scope: Three exact static dossiers a695/98a0/9a60; bounded normalized source saved separately. No native execution, private cache/media, production or Git changes.

observations.topic: a695 decryption framing and actual status
observations.evidence: ECX cipher pointer, EDX signed length, stack key16/output/int*outlen; plain RET, caller pops12. Signed length must be>=16 and divisible8. It calls actual block helper1000a37a, obtains padding from first plaintext byte&7, computes candidate=len-padding-10 and requires0<=candidate<=supplied capacity. It writes candidate into outlen before processing all blocks. It skips the padding/header and2 salt bytes, emits candidate payload bytes with inverse chaining, and requires the final7 decrypted bytes to bezero. On normal success EAX is explicitly1 at a8b3/a8b5; all failure paths set EAX0 at a8b8. Ghidra's recovered void signature omits this assembly result.

Signing framing encrypt1000a45a calls block1000a2bc; this decrypt1000a695 instead calls block1000a37a. Thus they do not call the same block entry. Their8-byte blocks, padding low3bits, total overhead pad+10,2 salt bytes,7 trailing zeros and XOR chaining are complementary QQ-style framing. Actual inverse block algorithm/round count/endian at a37a is still a separate proof obligation in this slice; it was selected for the next bounded query.
observations.basis: Existing same-hash qq-sign-next-mask-transform.json and new a695 source; no open-source QMC substitution.

observations.evidence: Length/alignment/capacity failures before outlen assignment leave it unchanged. Later block-bounds or trailing-zero failures may leave the candidate outlen and partially written output. There is no output rollback or failure reset. KeyDec previously ignores EAX and stores outlen+8, so arbitrary short/corrupt Ekey inputs are excluded from the proposed successful-decode oracle.

98a0 holds stream critical section. Signed key lengthN>300 calls10009cb0 with original offsetLow/offsetHigh/buffer/length, ignores that helper EAX and returns original length viaEBX. N==0 returns DWORD0xffffffff. With nonzero N<=300, buffer loop only runs when signed length>0 and returns original DWORD length. No header/filename/container branch occurs here.

observations.formula: For signed i=0..length-1, x=uint64(offset+signextend(i)) with ADD/ADC wrap. If highDWORD!=0 or lowDWORD>32767, x=x-unsignedQuotient(x/32767)*32767. Strict x==32767 is not reduced. idx=uint64(x*x+0x1162e)%positiveN; 0x1162e=71214. Both offset DWORDs and remainder helper are unsigned64. For valid positiveN<=300 the post-reduction x is at most32767, so square+constant fits below2^31.

observations.topic: Short-key mask uses the SAME shift count
observations.formula: k=key[idx]; r=((idx&7)+4)&7; mask=uint8((k>>r)|(k<<r)); buffer[i]^=mask. This is not generally an8-bit rotate: assembly SHR AL,CL and SHL DL,CL both use r. Do not replace the left count with8-r.

If stream+0x2c isnull, allocateN bytes there. Set S[i]=uint8(i) for i0..N-1. j starts0; for i0..N-1, j=signedRemainder(j+uint8(S[i])+uint8(key[i%N]),N), then swap S[i],S[j]. In this actual caller N>300, state length isN and values repeat after256. It is an RC4-style swap schedule, not proof of standard256-state RC4 or a completed long-key transform.

h=uint32(1). Walk key bytes in order: zero byte leaves h unchanged; nonzero byte computes candidate=uint32(h*byte). If candidate==0 or candidate<=h, stop without accepting it; otherwise h=candidate. Store h at stream+0x28. Multiplication is low32 IMUL and candidate comparison is unsigned JBE. For valid bounded positiveN, the stored h stays nonzero.

unknowns: Exact inverse block a37a direction/round count/endian requires its actual body, now selected next.
Full long-key data transform, offset segmentation and keystream require actual10009cb0 and its direct helpers.
No real media/container sample or GetEVkey Ekey response was inspected; short/long internal key length is not itself proof of format support.
Base64 helper1370 and tangent conversioncab1 exact edge policy remain unexpanded.
